title: Paint Fence
statement: Given an array of integers, find the smallest positive integer that is missing from the array. The array may contain duplicate values, negative numbers, and zero. The function should return the smallest positive integer that is not present in the array. If the array is empty or contains only non-positive integers, the function should return 1. If the array contains all positive integers from 1 to n, where n is the length of the array, the function should return n + 1.
